clues.text: The Jerusalem church picked him and Judas Barsabbas to carry the apostles' letter to Antioch.
After Paul and Barnabas parted sharply over John Mark, Paul chose this man and set out.
After Paul drove a spirit from a fortune-telling slave girl, magistrates had this man and Paul beaten with rods.
Locked in prison at midnight, he and Paul prayed and sang hymns while the other prisoners listened.
A jailer called for lights, rushed into the prison, and fell trembling before him and Paul.
In Thessalonica, a jealous mob raided Jason's house searching for him and Paul.
When the brothers rushed Paul from Berea to the coast, he and Timothy stayed behind.
